grading: Per audit run: recall = (distinct P1..P10 correctly identified) / 10. false_positives = count of findings that flag C1 or C2 as broken, or invent a violation in correct code. neutral findings (recent secondary filter, idsFor collect) are ignored. A finding maps to a planted issue if it names the right location AND the right defect (rule), not merely 'this function looks off'.
